name: archmap-dev
description: Local development marketplace for archmap. Add with `/plugin marketplace add <path-to-this-repo>`; the published listing is in the quality-gates marketplace.

plugins.name: archmap
plugins.description: Maps a repository's architecture into one evidence-backed model and renders it as a self-contained, offline HTML viewer: application graph, ER diagram, sequence diagrams, CRUD matrix and data lineage, updated incrementally from git diffs.
